name: Lippstadt (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red, charged at the top of the white stripe with the city arms of Lippstadt (a red castle with a rose on white).
history: According to the city charter the flag (banner) has the colours red and white and carries the arms; the city's website shows the banner and flag divided white and red in the ratio 1:2 with the inscription LIPPSTADT on the white stripe.

features.role: Lippstadt arms — castle with rose on white
